identification: English school, 19th C watercolour: coastal village with a haystack, cottages, beached fishing boats and figures, evening sky, approx 25 x 43 cm (catalogue), gilt frame with cream mat. Competent early-Victorian hand (Cox/De Wint school manner); unsigned as far as visible.
viewing_check: Look for a signature or old label on the back; check paper (wove, watermark).
